parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which falls under the Examples/SampleApp path hierarchy and carries is_sample_app=false only by flag but is structurally a sample-app file per the path convention. Per the restraint rules, any record under Examples/ or SampleApp/ triggers a no-action recommendation. Beyond the restraint marker, both records have empty name strings and empty fields_or_signature lists, so there is no substantive shared structure to extract or unify. The name collision on 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator' across 'DebugPanel' and 'Wallpaper' packages is therefore a coincidental artefact of both packages independently defining a type alias for the same standard-library nested type, not a duplication that warrants consolidation.
